insp.t: When taking damage equal to 20% of the hero's Max HP, has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 debuff on the hero. This skill only takes effect once during a period.
After each successful passive skill trigger, the stacks of Static consumed increase by only 1.
Accuracy +60
Each time Gatekeeper deals damage, it also reduces the hit target's Ultimate Energy by 5%.

p.t: Each time the hero casts a basic attack/battle skill/ultimate skill, gains 1/2/3 stack(s) of Static. Upon reaching 4 stack(s) of Static, consumes 4 stack(s) of Static to deal [+100%Attack]lightning damage to the nearest enemy, with a 75.0% chance to inflict Stunned for 3.0s, and the hero also gains a [+300%Attack]shield. Each time the passive skill triggers, the number of Static stacks required increases by 2, and the number of targets selected for damage and shielding increases by 1, up to 5 target(s).

b.t: Charges at the farthest enemy, dealing [+300%Attack]lightning damage, with a 100.0% chance to perform Knocked Up on them, and inflicts Attack Penalty II for 8.0s.

u.t: Deals [+300%Attack]lightning damage to all enemies, with a 100.0% chance to inflict 20% Resistance Penalty for 10.0s. Then grants all allies a [+25%Target's Max HP]shield and Gatekeeper.

insp.t: Damage dealt to enemies with a shield is increased by 20%.
Adds  to the random buffs granted by the battle skill, and additionally grants random buffs to 1 or 2 random allied Aura hero(es).
Crit Rate +10%,Crit Damage +20%

During the ultimate skill's duration, each time the hero deals Max HP-based damage to an enemy, has a 100.0% chance to inflict 5% Radiance Vulnerability on the enemy, lasting 10.0s and stacking up to 4 times.

p.t: When the hero's Aura Energy is full, grants 10 Aura Energy to the allied Aura hero with the highest Attack every 1s (this effect triggers once every 2.0s).\nWhen an allied Aura hero casts an ultimate skill, grants that ally 30% Damage Up for 10.0s.

b.t: Fires Magic Missiles at 3 random enemies, dealing [+150%Attack][+10%Max HP]radiant damage. At the same time, the hero consumes 15 Aura Energy, each time granting random buffs to up to 2 allied Aura hero(es) for 8.0s (including the following buffs: 20% Crit Rate Up, 30% Crit Damage Up, and 25% Attack Up).

u.t: Creates a magic nexus at the target location, dealing [+100%Attack]radiant damage to enemies within range every 1s. At the same time, the hero gains 5 Aura Energy. The magic nexus lasts 10s.\nWhile the magic nexus lasts, when enemies in range are attacked by Aura heroes with HP-boosted attacks, the hero gains 5 Aura Energy, and the hero deals an additional [+15%Max HP]radiant damage to the target.\nWhen the duration ends, deals [+200%Attack][+20%Max HP]radiant damage.

insp.t: When the hero's Mercy is full, grants all allies Defense Up II for 15s.
Mercy accumulation speed increases by 20%, and its cap increases by 20%.
When the hero's Mercy is full, inflicts 15% Vulnerability on a random enemy unit for 10s.

Repentance effect enhanced: Each time damage is taken, increases by current Mercy percentage * 30% (based on Mercy when the skill was cast). When this status is resisted, dispelled, or removed, the bearer loses 35% Ultimate Energy.

p.t: While Sia is on the field, all allied units gain a 10% Damage Bonus, take 10% less damage (including damage blocked by shields), and store 200% of the reduced damage as Mercy. Mercy is capped at her initial panel HP. When Mercy reaches the cap, it is fully consumed, restoring [20% Mercy]HP to all ally heroes and granting a shield equal to the same amount of Mercy for 10.0s. This effect can trigger only once every 20.0s.

b.t: Gains 15% Mercy, then inflicts Attack Penalty II for 8.0s. If current Mercy is at least 50% of the cap, additionally inflicts Recharging Speed Penalty for 5.0s.

u.t: Dispels 1 negative effect(s) from all allies, receives [25% of current Mercy]healing, grants an equal amount of shield for 10.0s, and grants Parry for 10.0s. Inflicts Repentance on all enemies for 10.0s.

insp.t: Heals the hero by [+8%Max HP] after killing an enemy.
Enhances the ultimate skill. When the hero gains Energy Drain Zone, dispels all debuffs and control effects from the hero. While the hero has Energy Drain Zone, damage dealt ignores Immortality.
Enlightenment +60
Enlightenment +60
Passive skill enhancement: while on the field, reduces all enemy units' Defense by [own current Enlightenment * 0.1%] (up to 60%). Enemies are no longer affected by Defense Penalty effects.

p.t: While on the field, reduces the Defense of enemy units within the area in front of the hero by [Current Enlightenment * 0.1%] (up to 50%). Enemies within range are no longer affected by Defense Penalty effects.

b.t: Grants 30% Attack Up to all allied Shadow School units for 8.0s, and deals 3 instances of [+160%Attack]Derivative to the target. Gains 5 Shadow Energy each time damage is dealt. The first time this skill is cast in battle, gains an additional 200% Shadow Energy.

u.t: Draws the hero and the enemy unit with the highest Attack into Energy Drain Zone for 5.0s. Then channels on the target for 5s, dealing [+100%Attack]Derivative to the target every 0.5s. For every 1% of HP the target has lost, this damage increases by 1%.

insp.t: The battle skill's range is increased to a 5x5 diamond area.

The random permanent buffs granted by the passive skill additionally include 5% Damage Bonus and 5% Damage Reduction, which can stack up to 3 times. When the passive skill grants buffs, it will not grant buffs that are already at maximum stacks.

The ultimate skill additionally inflicts Taunt on all enemies for 5s, ignoring Resistance. While the hero has Atonement, taking fatal damage grants immunity to the fatal damage once and immediately ends the Atonement state.
Enhances the ultimate skill effect. All allies convert Max HP along with the hero, and the conversion cap for allies increases to 35%.

p.t: Records 20% of damage taken (including damage blocked by shields) as healing, and heals all allies once every 5s. Each time the hero resists a debuff or control effect, grants all allies a permanent random buff (cannot transfer) among 5% Attack Up, Recovery Over Time, or Resistance Up II.

While Atonement lasts, the hero's damage taken increases by 20%. When Atonement ends, 25% of damage taken (including damage blocked by shields) is converted into the hero's Max HP, cumulatively up to 50% of the hero's initial Max HP. Once the hero's Max HP increase reaches the cap, the conversion applies to the Max HP of all allies except the hero instead, with each such ally capped cumulatively at 25% of that ally's initial Max HP.

b.t: Deals [+400%Attack]fire damage to enemies within range, heals the ally with the lowest HP by an amount equal to 100% of the highest single-instance damage, and removes 2 negative effects from that ally.

u.t: Deals [+500%Attack]fire damage to all enemies and has a 100.0% chance to inflict Attack Penalty II and Recharging Speed Penalty on them for 10.0s. The hero grants all allies Dodge Up II for 10.0s.

The number of targets healed by the battle skill increases to 5.

(This effect can trigger at most once every 20.0s.)

While the mark lasts:\nWhenever a Battle Soul unit triggers damage sharing, heals the 2 allied unit(s) with the lowest HP for Kushuhaar's [+15%Max HP]amount. This also applies Serpent Venom to the primary target for 15.0s, then permanently grants 2 Enlightenment to the Toxin inflicter and to the hero, up to 200 Enlightenment.

u.t: Charges and casts a spell, dealing [+800%Attack]Derivative to all enemies and transforming the battlefield floor into a poisonous swamp for 10s. While the swamp persists, each time an enemy takes direct Poison Damage, there is a 100% chance to apply Toxin for 15.0s. If Toxin is successfully applied, Serpent Spirit additionally applies 10% Damage Penalty for 10.0s. Enemies that die in the swamp cannot be Resurrected.

insp.t: Heals the hero by [+8%Max HP] after killing an enemy.
The passive skill triggers once allies have cumulatively gained 3 stacks of Rally.

p.t: Each stack of Rally Monelisse possesses reduces the damage she takes by 10%. When allies have collectively accumulated 5 stacks of Rally, Monelisse unleashes 1 volley of Crescent Strikes at the most densely packed enemies, dealing [+300%Attack]radiant damage to all enemies in range.

The hero then channels for 3s, directing 5 volleys of Crescent Strikes at the most densely packed enemies, dealing [+200%Attack]radiant damage to all enemies in a 3×3 area. The following effects are added in sequence by consuming stacks of Rally: [1] The Moonwave deals additional [+400%Attack]radiant damage. [2] Each Crescent Strike of the ultimate skill that hits the same target increases that hit's damage by 20%. [3] After activation, gains 25.0 Ultimate Energy.
